title: Meeting Spielberg about a video game in the middle of the dispute

tellings.quote: I went and sat in Steven Spielberg's office waiting. He comes in, shakes my hand, says, "Great to see you again." I

plain: In 1996, in the middle of a dispute, the screenwriter Bryce Zabel went to Amblin, Steven Spielberg's company in Los Angeles, to talk about a video game. Zabel tells Michels he sat waiting in Spielberg's office until Spielberg walked in, shook his hand and said, "Great to see you again."
